args.title: Juniper freight pricing summary (Q 2026)
args.body:
Combined summary of https://blog.juniper.example/2026/freight and its companion piece (https://insights.juniper.example/freight/companion):

- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter, while contract rates held steady.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
- Shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
